purpose: Teach: 構内/帰路/支度/坂道/久しい/差し入れ/ぼちぼち/口癖

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 駅構内、人多くて、疲れた。
lines.en: The station was packed. I'm exhausted.
lines.style: Quiet admission. Slight shoulder drop on the second sentence. Slow, drained rhythm. Not complaining—just stating fact. Trails into stillness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 帰路、カフェで一息ついて。
lines.en: Let's stop by the café on the way back. Catch our breath.
lines.style: Gentle invitation, steady and warm. Calm opening. Slight lift of care underneath—noticing without making it obvious. Unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 夕飯の支度、今日はサボる。
lines.style: Small, knowing smile in the voice. Light and a little defiant. Quick delivery. Permission given to herself, shared with Mei like a small conspiracy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 駅前の坂道、自転車止めるの、ちょっと怖い。
lines.en: That hill by the station—parking the bike there always makes me nervous.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly hesitant. Building from quiet observation into quiet worry. Measured pace, no rush to finish. Genuine small unease underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 久しい友達とも、会いたいな。
lines.en: It's been so long. I want to see them.
lines.style: Soft opening, then a gentle lift of longing. Slow, deliberate. Warmth mixed with a thread of missing something. The want is quiet but real.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: スイーツ、差し入れに、持っていくね。
lines.en: I'll bring some sweets to take to them.
lines.style: Bright and generous in tone. Quick, purposeful energy. Natural warmth—not performing it. The pleasure of giving is genuine and simple.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、自分のペース、ぼちぼちで保ってる。
lines.en: Lately I've been keeping my own pace. Steady, nothing rushed.
lines.style: Introspective, almost to herself. Slow, measured words. Quiet strength underneath. A pause before the second thought—gathering herself.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 「気にしない」が、私の口癖になってる。
lines.style: Soft, slightly self-aware. Gentle humor mixed with something tender. Closing warmth—directed at Mei. Fades into companionable quiet.
